dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, high-contrast white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts, appearing as a distinct, thin line.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp-edged pale white fringes are visible along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary feathers against dark gray centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, irregularly shaped white patch is visible on the posterior neck, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark plumage.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp and linear boundary exists between the black crown and the yellowish-olive mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast olive-yellow coloration of the mantle and back contrasting with the blue-gray hues of the lower wings and tail.
